rich_narrative.summary: Ta'leef Collective operates as a religious and community organization, but low financial efficiency and high executive compensation significantly limit its overall performance. In FY2024, the charity reported <cite id="3">$1,371,252 in total revenue</cite>, but directed only <cite id="3">11.7% of its expenses to program services</cite>. This program expense ratio is well below the standard 75% benchmark, leaving over 81% of spending allocated to administrative, fundraising, or operational overhead. In addition, CEO compensation was <cite id="3">$171,667 in FY2023</cite>, taking up over 12% of total revenue for an organization of modest size. The charity currently holds a <cite id="2">40/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite> and has met <cite id="2">0 of 20 BBB Wise Giving Alliance standards</cite>. On the program level, Ta'leef offers services such as Convert Care, facilitating <cite id="5">101 shahadas in 2023</cite> and serving an estimated <cite id="5">125 primary beneficiaries</cite> alongside weekly community attendees. While the organization maintains <cite id="1">zakat-eligible programs</cite> tailored for new Muslims and youth, donors must weigh these offerings against significant institutional overhead and limited data transparency.
